name: chums-baibot
description: Deploy and operate Chums baibot instances: the Matrix LLM bot with billing and x402 top-ups (bot container + payment sidecar) on a local or ssh-reachable Docker host. Use when the user asks to install, deploy, configure, update, restart, back up, inspect, health-check, read the logs of or remove a matrix bot, tron bot, chums bot or baibot.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy, configure, update and health-check Chums baibot instances (bot + x402 sidecar) over Docker, locally or over ssh.
